checks.statement: Use a dialog for a critical prompt that requires a decision or acknowledgement, and dedicate it to one task.
checks.condition: When a blocking prompt is necessary.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Dialogs guidance.

checks.statement: Use dialogs sparingly for blocking, critical information; use a non-blocking alternative such as a snackbar for low- or medium-priority information.
checks.condition: When choosing a message surface.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

checks.statement: State the dialog purpose with a brief, clear headline or question; avoid apologies, alarm, and ambiguous questions.
checks.condition: When a dialog has a headline.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Headline (optional) guidance.

checks.statement: Use no more than two dialog actions: a single action must acknowledge, and two actions must consist of one confirmation and one dismissal.
checks.condition: For dialog actions.
checks.notes: Corrected to isolate action count and roles; ordering and enabled-state rules are represented separately.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons guidance.
Separated the count and required action roles from ordering and enabled-state behavior.

checks.statement: Use full-screen dialogs for multi-step tasks or forms on compact breakpoints; use basic dialogs on medium and expanded breakpoints.
checks.condition: When adapting dialog variants.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Full-screen dialog guidance.

checks.statement: Use a specific confirmation label such as Create or Send, keep it enabled, and show another basic dialog only when confirmation fails.
checks.condition: For full-screen dialog confirmation.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Confirmation guidance.

checks.statement: When dismissing a full-screen dialog with unsaved changes, show a basic dialog asking whether to discard them.
checks.condition: For full-screen dialogs with unsaved changes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Dismissing guidance.

checks.statement: Show field errors inline and explain their cause and correction; show all field errors together, while general save/submit failures may use a basic dialog.
checks.condition: When dialog submission has errors.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Error messages guidance.

checks.statement: Use the close icon as the only app-bar navigation option in a full-screen dialog.
checks.condition: For full-screen dialogs.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Navigation guidance.

checks.statement: Avoid scrolling dialog content where possible; when scrolling is needed, pin the title above and actions below the content.
checks.condition: For scrollable dialogs.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling guidance.

checks.statement: On opening, move focus to the first interactive element and keep keyboard navigation within the dialog until it closes.
checks.condition: For keyboard users.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Initial focus guidance.

checks.statement: Use the dialog title as its accessibility label; on the web, expose a basic dialog with the alert-dialog role.
checks.condition: For dialog semantics.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

checks.statement: Keep app functionality unavailable while a modal dialog is open; it remains until the user confirms, dismisses it, or completes the required action.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: This is the modal blocking and persistence behavior stated in Usage.

sourceHistory.summary: This is the modal blocking and persistence behavior stated in Usage.

checks.statement: Use a snackbar rather than a dialog for low- or medium-priority information; snackbar messages may disappear automatically and may omit an action button.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves the source comparison table: snackbar is low importance/action optional, while dialog is high importance/action required.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the source comparison table: snackbar is low importance/action optional, while dialog is high importance/action required.

checks.statement: Communicate the dialog purpose through its headline and its buttons or other actionable items.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Separate purpose communication from headline wording and length.

sourceHistory.summary: Separate purpose communication from headline wording and length.

checks.statement: Keep dialog headlines succinct; they may wrap to a second line or be truncated. For full-screen dialogs, place long or variable-length headlines in content rather than the app bar.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves short headline, wrapping/truncation, and full-screen app-bar exception.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves short headline, wrapping/truncation, and full-screen app-bar exception.

checks.statement: Align dialog actions to the trailing edge, with the confirmation action closest to that edge; reverse the arrangement for RTL so confirmation is at the left edge.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Separates action placement from action count and enabled state.

sourceHistory.summary: Separates action placement from action count and enabled state.

checks.statement: Place the dismissive action to the left of the confirming action in LTR; do not put dismissal to the right of confirmation.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: The independent action-ordering rule from the captured button guidance.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures the two-action role and ordering instruction.

checks.statement: Use text buttons side by side by default; stack them when their labels are long, placing confirmation above dismissal.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Retains the action layout guidance from the captured section tail.

sourceHistory.summary: Retains the action layout guidance from the captured section tail.

checks.statement: Do not add a third “Learn more” dialog action; provide the information inline or before opening the dialog.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures the source guidance to avoid extra action and place information elsewhere.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures the source guidance to avoid extra action and place information elsewhere.

checks.statement: Use a basic dialog for urgent alerts, quick selection, and confirmation; it may contain lists, date pickers, or time pickers.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves supported basic-dialog use cases and contained controls.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves supported basic-dialog use cases and contained controls.

checks.statement: Require an action before a basic dialog closes; for date or time selection, let the user make a choice and then confirm it.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: The source says basic dialogs require action and examples confirm selection with OK.

sourceHistory.summary: The source says basic dialogs require action and examples confirm selection with OK.

checks.statement: Use a container-transform transition to transform a FAB into a full-screen dialog.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures the transition pattern named by the source.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures the transition pattern named by the source.

checks.statement: Allow other dialogs to appear over a full-screen dialog; it is the only dialog variant that can have dialogs above it.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures exclusive layering permission for the full-screen variant.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures exclusive layering permission for the full-screen variant.

checks.statement: In a full-screen dialog, use Save to commit a selection; use the close icon or a dismissive action such as Cancel or Back to close it.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves save versus dismiss action roles.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves save versus dismiss action roles.

checks.statement: A full-screen dialog may be used for a multi-step task, keyboard-input components, unsaved changes, or components that open additional dialogs.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Retains the source’s alternative qualifying task criteria.

sourceHistory.summary: Retains the source’s alternative qualifying task criteria.

checks.statement: Do not use the confirming action to dismiss a full-screen dialog.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Independent prohibition from the unsaved-change confirmation rule.

sourceHistory.summary: Independent prohibition from the unsaved-change confirmation rule.

checks.statement: Show an additional basic dialog only when the full-screen dialog confirmation action fails; do not show one merely because confirmation was selected.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Retains the failure condition and prevents redundant confirmation prompt.

sourceHistory.summary: Retains the failure condition and prevents redundant confirmation prompt.

checks.statement: Show all field errors at once so users can correct them before retrying.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Independent from error location and copy.

sourceHistory.summary: Independent from error location and copy.

checks.statement: For fields without built-in error messaging, such as checkboxes or radio buttons, add the error message next to the field.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves the stated exceptions for controls lacking built-in error messages.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the stated exceptions for controls lacking built-in error messages.

checks.statement: When launching a full-screen dialog, reset the app’s perceived elevation so simple menus or dialogs can appear above it; these overlays cover the screen rather than appearing as floating modal windows.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves overlay behavior described in the Dialog windows section.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves overlay behavior described in the Dialog windows section.

checks.statement: Allow the dialog variant to change with the breakpoint, such as changing a full-screen dialog to a basic dialog on a larger screen.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures responsive variant substitution.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures responsive variant substitution.

checks.statement: Center a basic dialog by default at medium breakpoints; its position may be overridden for ergonomics.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves default and optional positioning.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves default and optional positioning.

checks.statement: On expanded screens, a basic dialog may be custom-positioned anywhere while maintaining a 56dp margin from screen edges.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Carries through the exact 56dp edge margin.

sourceHistory.summary: Carries through the exact 56dp edge margin.

checks.statement: Use an enter-and-exit transition pattern when a dialog appears and disappears.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures the transition pattern instruction.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures the transition pattern instruction.

checks.statement: Keep a dialog in focus until dismissed or acted on; do not obscure it or show it partially on screen, except for full-screen dialogs.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves the focus retention and visibility exception.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves the focus retention and visibility exception.

checks.statement: Keep dialog scrolling independent from content outside the dialog, such as the background.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Separate scroll coupling rule from pinned title/actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Separate scroll coupling rule from pinned title/actions.

checks.statement: Ensure assistive-technology users can open and close a dialog, submit its interactive inputs, and scroll all content that overflows the container.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures each stated assistive outcome for dialog use.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures each stated assistive outcome for dialog use.

checks.statement: On Android, keep a headline short enough to fit within four lines at 200% text size; if it is truncated, provide a single-tap way to access the full content.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves platform scope, exact line threshold, and truncation alternative.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves platform scope, exact line threshold, and truncation alternative.

checks.statement: Apply the relevant accessibility guidance for every element contained in a dialog, including text fields, typography, and buttons.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: The source explicitly delegates contained elements to their own guidance.

sourceHistory.summary: The source explicitly delegates contained elements to their own guidance.

checks.statement: Keep Tab and Shift+Tab focus traversal inside the dialog, cycling from the last to first and first to last interactive elements respectively.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves keyboard table cycle relationships and direction.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves keyboard table cycle relationships and direction.

checks.statement: Let Space or Enter trigger or commit the focused element; Escape closes the dialog.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures keyboard actions from the table.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures keyboard actions from the table.

checks.statement: Label controls inside the dialog according to their own component accessibility guidance.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Distinct from the dialog-level label/role.

sourceHistory.summary: Distinct from the dialog-level label/role.

checks.statement: Use a dynamic-height basic dialog with 28dp corners and width from 280dp to 560dp; use 24dp outer padding, a 1dp divider, and a 24dp optional icon.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Values are taken from the captured measurement table, not inferred from the image.

sourceHistory.summary: Values are taken from the captured measurement table, not inferred from the image.

checks.statement: Center-align basic dialog content with an icon and start-align it without an icon; keep 16dp between title and body and icon and title, 24dp between body and actions, and 8dp between buttons.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Preserves conditional alignment and the separate spacing relationships in the table.

sourceHistory.summary: Preserves conditional alignment and the separate spacing relationships in the table.

checks.statement: Use a dynamic-height full-screen dialog with 0dp corner radius and a maximum width of 560dp; use a 56dp header and bottom action bar, 24dp top/side padding, and a 24dp close icon.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Values are sourced from the captured full-screen measurement table.

sourceHistory.summary: Values are sourced from the captured full-screen measurement table.

checks.statement: Start-align the full-screen headline; use 8dp between elements and a 1dp optional divider.
checks.condition: For the dialog variant or interaction described by the source.
checks.notes: Captures the text alignment and spacing values.

sourceHistory.summary: Captures the text alignment and spacing values.

checks.statement: Place a temporary scrim over the surface behind the dialog to make background content less prominent and focus attention on the dialog.
checks.condition: While a dialog is displayed above app content.
checks.notes: The source assigns the scrim the purpose of reducing the prominence of underlying surfaces.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the scrim purpose of reducing the prominence of background content.

checks.statement: Keep the full-screen dialog confirmation action enabled.
checks.condition: When showing a confirmation action in a full-screen dialog.
checks.notes: Specific full-screen confirmation rule; basic dialog action enablement is addressed by the existing separate action rule.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the requirement not to disable a full-screen dialog confirmation action.

checks.statement: Disable a confirming action until a required choice is made, but never disable a dismissive action.
checks.condition: When dialog confirmation depends on a required choice.
checks.notes: The captured button guidance distinguishes the enabled state of confirming and dismissive actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured distinct enabled-state requirements for confirming and dismissive actions.

checks.statement: Implement dialog color values through design tokens; design values should correspond to tokens, and implementation values should reference token values.
checks.condition: When assigning dialog color roles.
checks.notes: The two specs color sections repeat this token requirement; role-to-element diagrams are image-only and remain unresolved.

sourceHistory.summary: Captured the explicit design-token requirement from the basic dialog color section.
